words.ex: Sometimes I take the train instead of driving.

words.def: In most cases; what normally happens.
words.ex: I usually wake up at seven.

words.def: used to say something seems like another thing, but it may not be true
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.

words.def: using something as the starting point or main idea
words.ex: The movie is based on a true story.

words.def: used to say something stays true whatever the condition is
words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.

words.def: used to talk about something that may happen or be true
words.ex: If you are tired, you can rest.

words.def: because something might happen, so you prepare for it
words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

words.def: used to show the reason why someone does something
words.ex: She woke up early in order to catch the train.

words.def: and nothing or no one else; not more than
words.ex: I only have five minutes.

words.def: used to say something will happen only if another thing is true
words.ex: You can borrow the car provided that you drive carefully.

words.def: used to say something is fine if a condition is met
words.ex: You can stay here so long as you are quiet.

words.def: used to say something happens only if another thing does not happen
words.ex: We will have a picnic unless it rains.

words.def: used to ask about or point to one thing from a group
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?

words.def: used to ask about the way something is done or its condition
words.ex: How do you make this soup?

words.def: used to ask about a thing or to get information
words.ex: What time does the movie start?

words.def: used to ask which person does or did something
words.ex: Who left the door open?

words.def: used as the object when asking about a person, in formal speech
words.ex: To whom should I send this letter?

words.def: used to ask who owns something or something belongs to
words.ex: Whose bag is this on the chair?

words.def: coming after the ninth thing in a list or order
words.ex: She finished tenth in the race.

words.def: coming before all others in time, order or position
words.ex: This is my first day at the new job.

words.def: coming right after the first one in order
words.ex: He lives on the second floor.

words.def: coming right after the second one in order
words.ex: Our team came in third place.

words.def: coming right after the third one in order
words.ex: The fourth question was the hardest.

words.def: coming right after the fourth one in order
words.ex: My birthday is on the fifth of May.

words.def: coming right after the fifth one in order
words.ex: She is in the sixth grade.

words.def: coming right after the sixth one in order
words.ex: Saturday is the seventh day of the week.

words.def: Coming after seven other things in a list or order.
words.ex: She finished eighth in the race.

words.def: Coming after eight other things in a list or order.
words.ex: My birthday is on the ninth of May.

words.def: Used to accept that something is true before giving a different point.
words.ex: Granted that it is expensive, the quality is excellent.

words.def: used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement seem surprising
words.defT: משמש להצגת עובדה שגורמת למשפט העיקרי להיראות מפתיע
words.ex: Although it was raining, we went for a long walk.
words.exT: למרות שירד גשם, יצאנו להליכה ארוכה.

words.def: Ways in which things are not the same.
words.ex: There are many differences between the two cities.

words.def: The ways something can be employed to do a job.
words.ex: This tool has many uses in the kitchen.

words.def: Used to introduce a thing that shows what you mean.
words.ex: I like fruit, for instance, apples and grapes.

words.def: People who study nature and the world using careful tests.
words.ex: Scientists discovered a new kind of frog.

words.def: Must be done or had because a rule says so.
words.ex: Students are required to wear a uniform.

words.def: In every part of the earth, in many countries.
words.ex: People all over the world enjoy football.

words.def: Usual or normal, not special; the middle amount of a group.
words.ex: The average temperature here is twenty degrees.
words.exT: הטמפרטורה הממוצעת כאן היא עשרים מעלות.
